agencyName: Colorado Secretary of State (State Electrical Board Rules)
authorityRationale: The actual, literal regulation text (3 CCR 710-1) governing the Colorado State Electrical Board, hosted by the Colorado Secretary of State — the single strongest source class found across all of Phase 2D's research. Contains the verbatim statement that a Colorado master electrician's license may not be granted by reciprocity.
reliabilityRationale: Primary statutory/regulatory text itself, not a summary or application page — the highest possible reliability class for this kind of fact.
